metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Egypt's Toshka Lakes decrease in June 2012 compared to September 2002?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare surface water extent between two time periods: September 2002 and June 2012 - Location: Toshka Lakes, Egypt (approximately 22.5°N, 30.5°E) - For 2002: Landsat 7 ETM+ or Landsat 5 TM available - For 2012: Landsat 7 ETM+ (with SLC-off issues) or Landsat 5 TM - Alternative: Use JRC Global Surface Water dataset which has monthly water occurrence data 2. Masking strategy: - Need to identify water pixels, so should mask clouds/shadows - Use water indices like NDWI or MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) - MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) works well for water detection - Or use JRC Surface Water which already has water classification 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - If water extent decreases: Answer A (Yes) - If water extent increases or stays same: Answer B (No) - If no images found: C1 - If no valid pixels after masking: C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN: C3 I'll use Landsat data with MNDWI for water detection, with fallback to JRC if needed. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Toshka Lakes area in Egypt const toshka = ee.Geometry.Point([30.5, 22.5]).buffer(30000); // 30km buffer around Toshka Lakes // 2. Date ranges const date2002_start = '2002-09-01'; const date2002_end = '2002-09-30'; const date2012_start = '2012-06-01'; const date2012_end = '2012-06-30'; // 3. Helper function to calculate water extent using MNDWI function calculateWaterExtent(collection, geometry) { const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { return null; } // Create composite and calculate MNDWI const composite = collection.median(); const mndwi = composite.normalizedDifference(['B2', 'B5']).rename('mndwi'); // Green - SWIR // Threshold for water (MNDWI > 0 typically indicates water) const water = mndwi.gt(0); // Count water pixels const stats = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels = stats.get('mndwi').getInfo(); const totalPixels = water.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('mndwi').getInfo(); return { waterPixels: waterPixels, totalPixels: totalPixels, imageCount: size }; } // 4. Try Landsat 7 for 2002 let col2002 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(toshka) .filterDate(date2002_start, date2002_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size2002 = col2002.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2002 Landsat 7 images found: ${size2002}`); if (size2002 === 0) { // Try Landsat 5 for 2002 col2002 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(toshka) .filterDate(date2002_start, date2002_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); size2002 = col2002.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2002 Landsat 5 images found: ${size2002}`); } if (size2002 === 0) { console.log('No data for September 2002.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 5. Try Landsat 7 for 2012 let col2012 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(toshka) .filterDate(date2012_start, date2012_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let size2012 = col2012.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2012 Landsat 7 images found: ${size2012}`); if (size2012 === 0) { // Try Landsat 5 for 2012 col2012 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(toshka) .filterDate(date2012_start, date2012_end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); size2012 = col2012.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2012 Landsat 5 images found: ${size2012}`); } if (size2012 === 0) { console.log('No data for June 2012.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Calculate water extent for both periods const result2002 = calculateWaterExtent(col2002, toshka); const result2012 = calculateWaterExtent(col2012, toshka); if (result2002 === null || result2012 === null) { console.log('Failed to process imagery.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`2002: Water pixels = ${result2002.waterPixels}, Total pixels = ${result2002.totalPixels}`); console.log(`2012: Water pixels = ${result2012.waterPixels}, Total pixels = ${result2012.totalPixels}`); // 7. Check for valid pixels if (result2002.totalPixels === 0 || result2012.totalPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 8. Check for calculation validity if (result2002.waterPixels === null || result2012.waterPixels === null || isNaN(result2002.waterPixels) || isNaN(result2012.waterPixels)) { console.log('Calculation returned invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Compare water extents const waterArea2002 = result2002.waterPixels * 9; // 3000m scale = 9 km² per pixel const waterArea2012 = result2012.waterPixels * 9; console.log(`2002 water area: ${waterArea2002.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2012 water area: ${waterArea2012.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${(waterArea2012 - waterArea2002).toFixed(2)} km²`); // 10. Final answer if (waterArea2012 < waterArea2002) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
